title: AI Has Your Head Spinning? Get Ready for Quantum Computing
excerpt: AI already has your head spinning. Get ready for quantum computing, the next technology to watch in an amazing, fast-changing era.
content:
The stock market is warning us that the investing public hasn’t figured out what to make of AI: As this is written, Anthropic is down again today (by 12 percent), already giving back much of its gains after going public this week.

Into that fray, the New York Times has a big report today on the imminence of quantum computing. To cut to the chase, there are competing building methodologies, Google has its hand in both of them, and they are starting to solve the problem of error correction, which the report explains is a major hurdle to “the creation of a usable quantum computer.” While the technology has been decades in the making, it appears possible that usable quantum computing could be a reality by the end of this decade or soon after.

Quantum computing is not so much a competitor of AI as it is a hardware revolution that could make AI software capability significantly more powerful. And AI is proving vital to transforming quantum computing from theory to real-world capability.

We’re living in a transformative age, and there are more jolts coming. Soon.
